Decision to make

You support an internal knowledge desk. Draw intake, validation, review, approval and closed states.

Core concept

Explicit states make retries and handoffs inspectable. Define legal transitions and terminal states. A retry must detect completed work rather than duplicate an action.

Practice contract

Evidence and boundary

Review and reflect
